description.value: Hope Bike Park is a large, free-admission public bike park in Hope, BC, designed for riders from beginner to expert with progression-focused terrain for both BMX and mountain biking. Set against forested hillsides and mountain scenery, the park has been operating since at least 2015 and receives ongoing professional trail maintenance from crews like Hoots Inc. It is a genuine cycling destination in the Fraser Valley, accessible to the public at no cost.
